observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale. South: a dark, armoured creature seen from the front. Two huge segmented forelimbs arch up and outward, ending in curved dark-red sickle hooks that drip blood. A small plated body sits between them, with a ringed tubular siphon hanging down from the centre and its open bore facing the viewer. Six thin jointed legs with red-tipped claws. East: a side profile. Both great forelimbs reach forward and up in an 'F' shape, the siphon curves forward and down and drips, the small plated abdomen trails to the left, and the thin legs stand on the ground. North: nearly the same composition as south. Two arms arch upward, there is a plated body, and the ringed siphon hangs down at the bottom centre with its bore toward the camera. The legs splay the same way. It does not read as the back end: no abdomen tip or tail is shown, and the siphon (the head part) is still in front.
observed.south.png: Full-res south: blackened, segmented chitin-like armour, painterly with soft highlights, blood-red hook tips with drips. The siphon points at the viewer and its bore is visible. Clean transparent background.
observed.east.png: Full-res east: a clear lateral profile. The forelimbs dominate the silhouette, the segmented abdomen is small, and the siphon extends forward, dripping. Clean alpha, no ground.
observed.north.png: Full-res north: a symmetric view with the forelimbs raised vertically. The ringed siphon hangs at the bottom centre, open bore toward the camera, as on south. Under the body is a plated 'thorax' read from the front. No tail or abdomen end is visible. It looks like the front view again with the arms posed differently.
observed.scale.png: Beside the vanilla human at max zoom the creature is about one cell wide, low and spidery, smaller than the human. At 32 px/cell it reads as a dark spiky silhouette with raised arms.

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South: a round mass of pinkish-red flesh studded with many brown-irised eyeballs of different sizes, with one large central eye. Two eyestalks rise from the top, each ending in a large eye facing the viewer. About ten thin, jointed, bony legs with pointed tips splay out from underneath. East: the same mass in profile, moving right. A very large eye sits at the front (right), with smaller eyes packed behind it. The two stalks are offset, the far one shorter, and the stalk eyes look right. The legs are spread in a walking pose. North: the same flesh mass seen from behind. Every eye shows only its veined white back, with no iris or pupil. The two stalks end in pale veined bulbs (the backs of the stalk eyes). Legs as in the other views. Heights look about equal.
observed.south.png: Full-resolution south view: the eye-cluster faces the camera. The eyes look wet and glossy and are packed into a red, veined flesh matrix. There is no mouth, jaw or fur. The two eyestalks are symmetric, the legs come straight out from under the cluster, and the alpha is clean.
observed.east.png: Full-resolution east profile: the body is lopsided, with a dominant large front eye and smaller eyes behind. The stalks lean forward, and the legs are jointed and spidery with pointed feet. The cutout is clean.
observed.north.png: Full-resolution rear view: rounded pale globes (the backs of the eyeballs), with red veins showing through, are bunched in the red flesh. No pupils or iris are visible anywhere. The stalks end in pale bulbs, and the legs splay underneath. The cutout is clean.
observed.scale.png: Beside the vanilla human at max zoom the creature is small, roughly knee-height or smaller and about half a cell across. At normal play (32 px per cell) it is a tiny reddish speck, smaller than the rat; the white eye dots barely read.

observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale. Each shows a long, smooth, fleshy pink-red cord with fine longitudinal muscle striations. It hangs from a short clump of bark and dark green leaves at the top and ends in a toothed jaw at the bottom. South: the jaw is an oval maw gaping straight at the camera, with a ring of ivory fangs and a dark red gullet. East: the cord drops straight, then bends forward at the bottom into a J-shape; the jaw is seen in profile, gaping to the right with long curved fangs. North: almost the same as south, an open gaping maw facing the camera with fangs around a dark throat, slightly more flared and lobed. All three are the same height.
observed.south.png: Full resolution of the south view: a leafy bark clump at the top fans into a fibrous cord that runs straight down to a teardrop-shaped bulb. The bulb is a wide-open mouth facing the viewer with long upper and lower fangs. There are no eyes and no skull. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: Full resolution of the east view: a bark clump with leaves, tilted a little, at the top. A straight cord runs down and hooks forward at the bottom into a profile jaw that gapes toward the east with large curved fangs. The hook makes a J-shaped base. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Full resolution of the north view: the same leaf clump and cord, ending in a flared, lobed mouth that opens toward the viewer. Fangs ring a dark red throat. Nothing shows the back or outer surface of the jaw. No eyes. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom, beside a vanilla human, the creature (east view) is about 2.2 cells tall, taller than the human, with the leaf clump at the top and the jaw near the human's foot level. At 32 px/cell (normal play), it reads as a thin pink line with a leafy top and a pinkish hook at the bottom, about as tall as the human.

SOUTH_FRONT.seen: South shows the open jaw facing the camera head-on, which is the creature's front.

NORTH_REAR.seen: North shows an open, fanged maw gaping toward the camera, almost a mirror of south. It should show the closed outer back of the jaw. There are no eyes, but the 'face' (the mouth) is on the rear view.

NO_OVERHEAD.seen: All three are side-on hanging views. None is overhead.

SAME_SIZE.seen: The measured spread is 3%, and visually the three are the same.

SAME_ANIMAL.seen: The same cord, leaf clump and fanged jaw appear on all three, and the jaw turns into profile on east. North duplicating the front is covered under NORTH_REAR.

SIGNATURE.seen: A mouth on a tendon: a long muscular cord ending in a free jaw is plainly legible.

ALIEN.seen: No Earth animal is a jaw on a hanging cord. It does not read as a snake or a lamprey at a glance.

DEPARTURES.seen: 1 present: a bare striated cord with no scales and no torso thickening (it widens only at the jaw bulb). 2 present: the top fans into a clump of bark and leaves with no coiling around a branch, though the clump is small. 3 present: just a jaw, with no eyes, skull or neck. 4 mostly present: it hangs straight on all facings; east hooks the jaw forward at the bottom but this is not an S-curve or a raised strike. 5 present: no limbs and no tail.

STYLE.seen: Painterly flesh texture with muscle striations and realistic fangs. Not cute, not cel-shaded.

OURS.seen: A bespoke invented design, not a vanilla or other-mod animal.

ALPHA.seen: Clean cut-out on the checkerboard, with no ground, shadow or halo.

SCALE.seen: About 2 cells tall hanging beside the human, which suits a canopy ambusher with drawSize 1.7.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px it reads as a thin pink line with a leaf tuft and a hooked tip. It is thin but separate from the ground. It is weak as a bold shape, so this is a polish note at most.
